   denoting a state, as in afoot, on foot, abed, amiss, asleep, aground,
   aloft, away (AS. onweg), and analogically, ablaze, atremble, etc. (2)

   a- (Goth. us-, ur-, Ger. er-), usually giving an intensive force, and
